kind: semantic toy model; no distributed runtime or performance validation
checks: all delivery orders and duplicates converge to the same winning slots
partial overwrite removes the entire old wide glyph, without resurrecting older glyphs
grouped reduction is associative, commutative and idempotent
retiring an old cohort preserves a newer overwrite and rejects delayed expired records
a receiver with only half a wide operation displays neither half
alternating scattered x/y growth and shrink retains a rectangular torus and stable data addresses
a removed cursor redirects to a surviving neighbour and the next input uses that place
a cut wide glyph stays destroyed even if its slots become adjacent again later
fully occupied rows still admit growth and forced removal
limitations: dense in-process geometry directory; no distributed index implementation
scalar stamps stand in for server-issued HLC/order keys
cohort admission floor is assumed agreed and is not a consensus implementation
geometry fracture detection is explicit; incremental distributed detection is unimplemented
no network partitions, lease handover, real browser, GPS projection or throughput validation
